purpose: Promotion checklist for the first daily public-source ingestion slice.
reviewGates: JSON parsing succeeds for every changed JSON file.
DailySourceIngestion batch is discoverable through the worker batch list.
Daily OpenAI runs require OpenAI__PublicSourceApiKey and must not fall back to a private or generic OpenAI API key.
No source artifact contains secrets, customer facts, private operations, private provider tactics, payment data, identity data, or raw prompts.
The PR remains draft or review-gated until a human reviews the daily ingestion contract.
rollbackInstructions: Revert the PR before merge if the contract is not acceptable.
After merge, open a corrective PR that removes this daily source-ingestion folder and unwires manifest, artifact-index, citation-map, regression-matrix, llms.txt, README, and run-queue references.
If a safety issue is discovered, replace the unsafe artifact with a public-safe correction note instead of leaving ambiguous generated source records in place.
